title: Combine Errors: tryMap, catch & replaceError
hints: `tryMap` turns a thrown error into a failed stream.
Errors end a stream; recovering outside means the rest of the input is lost.
Handle the error inside `flatMap { Just($0).tryMap(…).replaceError(with: -1) }` to continue.
jsBridge: `tryMap`, `catch` and `replaceError` are RxJS's `map` + `catchError`. A failure **terminates** the stream in both, which is why recovery operators matter.

compass.q: RxJS `catchError(() => of(-1))` vs Combine `.catch { _ in Just(-1) }`: same termination semantics?
After an error, does the upstream keep emitting? How do you keep a long-lived stream alive (`flatMap` + `catch` inside)?
`replaceError(with:)` vs `catch` vs `retry(_:)`: which for which failure?
A search stream dies on the first network error. How do you structure it so the next query still works?
